# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This batch of call transcripts is very noisy. Out of ~150+ files, only a minority are genuine sales conversations (rate enquiries, stock checks, negotiation, payment/dispatch coordination for steel material). A large share of the corpus is:

- Pure internal/logistics chatter (crane/loading, driver coordination, TC/bill handovers, cutting-machine operator calls to "Yuvraj Operator" about coil thickness/diagonal checks).
- Personal/unrelated conversations in Hindi/Gujarati (the "Vishal" and "Veer" call series) — family talk, cricket, silver/gold market gossip, not sales at all.
- One-line hang-ups, voicemails, wrong numbers.

The real sales calls that remain show a consistent pattern: BSC is a **steel trading/distribution company** (dealer-level, not a primary mill) that sources **TMT rebar, MS plates/sheets, structural steel (ISMB/ISMC/angles/flats/SHS), round bars and CRS material** from major mills (SAIL, RINL/Vizag, Vaisakh, Tata Steel, JSW, NMDC) and resells to fabricators, engineers, builders, traders and institutions (colleges, hospitals) around Chennai/Tamil Nadu, with some interstate dispatch (Odisha, AP, Gudur, Vellore). Given the volume of genuine sales exchanges, insights below are grounded only in those calls — this is a **short, honest** distillation, not a large dataset.

## Products & brand ladder

**Core products actually discussed:**
- **TMT rebar / rods** — grades FE500, 500D, 550D, E250, E350; lengths 6m/12m discussed, cutting generally refused ("TMT-ல நம்ம 6 meter எப்பவுமே கொடுக்கலையே").
- **CRS (cold-rolled sections/sale CRS)** — 20mm size quoted; only 500D manufactured currently in CRS, not 550D.
- **MS Plates / Checkered plates** — thicknesses from 2mm to 25mm+, standard sheet sizes 2500×1250, 6300mm coil-cut lengths; "NMDC" plates mentioned for plate segment.
- **Structural steel** — ISMB, ISMC (C-channel), ISA/MS angles, SHS (square hollow section — explicitly "SHS நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல sir"), flats, round bars.
- **Pipes/tubes** — square/rectangular pipes explicitly NOT stocked ("pipes நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல").
- **Coils** — cut-to-size sheet/coil service for customers needing specific plate dimensions.

**Brand ladder (as referenced by reps/customers):**
- **Sail (SAIL)** and **Vaisakh** — "ரெண்டுமே same price தான் sir" — interchangeable at the trading level.
- **Vizag (RINL)** — frequently the *only* stock available ("Sail இப்போ stock இல்லை... Vizag-ல தான் இருக்கு"); sometimes flagged as **"Vizag is not approved"** for certain govt/bank-funded sites.
- **Tata Steel / JSW** — used by customers as benchmark/competitor pricing; reps explain quality/spec (grade, weight/kg, flange thickness) differences to justify gaps.
- **NMDC** — plate-specific brand.
- Govt/bank project approval language appears ("government bank-ஆ approved... Sale, Vaisakha") — i.e., brand choice is sometimes constrained by project funding/approval requirements.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- TMT (5.5m): quoted **₹54**, negotiated down to **₹53.5** final + GST + loading + transport extra.
- ISMB: **₹61** general, dropped to **₹60** in one call, later re-quoted **₹63** citing rate increase; weight-based alternative offered (300×150 @ ~42kg/m vs 300×140 @ ~46kg/m, ~₹3,000/ton cheaper but lower flange thickness).
- 8mm sheet (2500mm): **₹65.5/kg**, earlier was ₹58–59.
- 20mm sale CRS: **₹69,000** (lump sum quote, loading negotiable/free for the customer).
- TMT 12mm **₹69**, 16mm **₹68.5** + GST extra (quoted to an institutional buyer).
- MS Plate range seen across multiple Vinayaga Steel calls: **₹59.5 to ₹66/kg** depending on thickness and week (steel prices described as rising ~₹1,000–1,500/month in several calls).
- TMT/structural (Zetwork Harish): **₹62–63.5/kg**, with **+₹500 extra for 12mm** due to coil-cutting cost; competitor benchmark cited as ₹62 by rival sellers.
- Transport/freight actually quoted: Gudur ₹18/ton
